summary: One internal design system, centralized Query transport/mutations, declarative private routes and server-enforced MFA/session boundaries.
acceptance: Native controls live only inside the DS and lint prevents bypasses; existing forms, tables, orange/light theme and mobile side panels remain usable.
Every application request uses same-origin transport and centralized Query factories/mutations with tenant/user keys and explicit invalidation.
Anonymous, expired or unassured sessions cannot mount tenant screens; identity changes cancel and clear cached sensitive data.
Production MFA requires real TOTP enrollment or one-use recovery with per-session server proof; stale sessions and management/trusted-device bypasses are denied.
Strict types, lint, units, actual PostgreSQL HTTP tests, browser fixtures and production-container smoke pass before merge.
semanticRouting: Cross-cutting UI, remote data, identity, schema and deployment hardening; no change to logistics financial rules, extraction or external connectors. Product acceptance is existing requested consistency plus required MFA for sensitive-data pilot; UX and security separately reviewed.
